title: Report a limited observation
stimulus: An editor receives this sentence: “If the city replaced the lamps last month, the electricity use will fall last month.” Records show that the lamps were replaced, and use was lower that month. No causal study was done.
task: Write one or two sentences reporting the observed events. Remove the time inconsistency and avoid claiming a proven cause.
answer: The city replaced the lamps last month, and electricity use was lower that month. The records do not establish whether the lamp replacement caused the decrease.
explanation: A conjunction such as and reports co-occurrence. Because would add a causal conclusion beyond the records.

title: 区分买和卖
stimulus: 甲：你买什么？乙：我买水果。丙：这家店卖水果。
task: 先读三句话，再单独读“买”和“卖”。请听者判断哪个词是购买，哪个是出售。

explanation: 同一个声母和韵母配上不同声调可以区别词义。读词组时，第三声不必每次都完整升起来。
